game_concept: A adventure race set in Snowy Hold – Firewood Stacks, towering firewood stacks: the frost mage must handle winter bandits while practicing functions. Core idea – Function Pipeline: Chain one function's output into the next to push hot soup pots down a processing line.
theme: Snowy Hold – Firewood Stacks: towering firewood stacks
core_gameplay_loop: In Firewood Stacks, repeat each round: Chain one function's output into the next to push hot soup pots down a processing line. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the frost mage ahead. Then check the pipeline value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the frozen well by solving code steps involving pipeline that move the frost mage forward.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.55).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the frozen well first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 2 (intro tier): Function Pipeline
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Function Pipeline' (Week 6 slot 5), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Firewood Stacks'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Snowy Hold
region.mood: soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how pipeline changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against winter bandits in Firewood Stacks.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.55).
